notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
- Fixing issue where number of collectables was wrongly reported for achievement purposes.
- Added the check for the achievements at the start of the game for people whose collectable count was previously corrupted by the other issue in this patch.

notes.title: Minor Update

- Fixing minor visual issue with the intro cinematic.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
We are very excited to finally announce the official release date for Planet Cube: Edge. This exciting precision platformer will be hitting Steam in less than one month on the 23rd of February 2023!

One of the developers at Sunna Entertainment, Emilio Monge Vasquez (CTO), shares with us:

"After years in the making, the launch date is finally here and we couldn't be happier for everyone to be able to enjoy Planet Cube Edge. The game reflects our original vision of quality, fun and variety for fans of the genre. And for newer fans of the genre, our vision of having an accessible precision platformer. Our focus was making a challenging game that helps you beat it, but doesn't do it in a way that takes away from that excitement of beating a challenging part.
 
Player feedback has been extremely positive from the first time we showcased it in public to these last few days when people playtested the full version. The launch date marks the start of players worldwide enjoying Planet Cube Edge, and we can't wait to see the reception!”

For more information, check out the Steam page, and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!
